_about: The music -> gameplay mapping the composer reads. Every number here is a decision somebody can change after watching a cut; LEARNINGS.md says why each one is what it is. Features are normalised against the SONG (0..1), not the segment, so a quiet song's loudest bar still reads as its drop.

archetypes.name: skim-race-chase
archetypes.what: A Squirrel on the Skim Race rails from just behind: speed, the rail flashing past, rings ahead. The driving, forward-motion beat.

archetypes.name: skim-race-flyby
archetypes.what: The pack of racers passing the camera on the rails with their wakes: a fixed vantage the race sweeps through. For a bar that lifts.

archetypes.name: wildlife-cage-wide
archetypes.what: The Wildlife Liberation cage from inside, the fleet threading its lattice with brittlestar swarms around it: texture and breath. For a breakdown or a held bar.

archetypes.name: wildlife-cage-chase
archetypes.what: Chasing a vessel through the cage's shells, prisms whipping past on every side. Dense, claustrophobic drive.

archetypes.name: joust-melee
archetypes.what: Twelve vessels jousting in one arena of crystal: ride one jouster through the melee, magenta and cyan wakes crossing the cavern. The drop. (An orbit wider than ~40 u sits inside the prism mass at I3+, so the drop rides a hull.)

archetypes.name: joust-orbit
archetypes.what: A tight orbit on one jouster inside the crystal cavern (close enough to stay in the open air around it).
